description: Fix and guard against the 2026-07-17 user-reported GPU-OOM crash: a create_bind_group panic (buffer binding 6 range 2758820944 exceeds max_*_buffer_binding_size 2147483647) implying ~10-20M mesh instances from a runaway spawn path or unbounded persisted data. Cap every spawn path, guard degenerate scales, eliminate double-materialization, add an instance-count watchdog with a user-visible warning, and verify a clean live app run against the user's existing data/ database
notes:
P0 user-reported crash, live-DB repro. HARD RULE: never delete/reset/overwrite anything under data/ — it is the user's live database; reading and launching against it is allowed. Existing partial guards to build on, not duplicate: fe-ui/src/verse_manager/path_asset_reconcile.rs MAX_STAMPS=4096 + sanitize_world_scale. Crash chain: bevy_pbr prepare_mesh_bind_groups + prepare_preprocess_bind_groups panic ('preprocess_gpu_indexed_frustum_culling_bind_group'), then host allocation failure (2703360 bytes) -> STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN on a memory-constrained Windows machine. VALIDATED 2026-07-19: in_progress (conservative call, per coordinator ground-truth guidance). Evidence: commit 46e19de (2026-07-17) fixed root cause (duck.glb embedded camera -> 8,192 stamped Camera3d instances -> 16,387 extracted views -> 2.76GB create_bind_group panic) via fe-renderer/src/camera.rs deactivate_foreign_cameras, WITH a committed verification note ('Verified: 309s run at full frame rate, 0 validation errors, views max 3, data_buffer ~1.5MB was 2.76GB') satisfying FR-5's primary acceptance gate at the commit-author level. FR-1-4 (caps/sanitize/idempotent-reconcile/watchdog) confirmed present via git grep: MeshInstanceBudget + MAX_PETAL_NODES wired across fe-ui/src/verse_manager/{spawn,petal_respawn,primitive_materialize,db_results/*}.rs and fe-ui/src/plugin.rs/settings.rs. spec.md 'Root cause + resolution' section serves as the Phase-1 audit writeup even though plan.md's Phase-1 checkboxes are stale/unchecked (same stale-checkbox pattern as other tracks in this repo). HOWEVER remaining gaps keep this in_progress not done: (1) no retro.md exists in this track folder — Phase 3's 'Retro + archive' task never executed; (2) FR-6 (Phase 4, render-distance-gated spawning) — git grep confirms a residency-ledger render_distance mechanism IS implemented (fe-ui/src/verse_manager/path_asset_materialize.rs:252, petal_respawn.rs:89, primitive_materialize.rs:151 all consume `residency.settings.render_distance`), BUT it landed under commit 320ebfe (2026-07-18) attributed to the p2p_asset_streaming/D-74/D-78 track, not through THIS track's own Phase-4 plan tasks (all still unchecked here) — cross-track delivery, not verified against this track's own acceptance bar (dense-petal camera-locality live-run, per Phase 4's explicit task, is unrecorded); (3) commit 320ebfe's own message states 'NOT in-app verified' for the broader work that includes the residency ledger, and MEMORY.md's 2026-07-19 in-app-regression-fixes note confirms the user DID launch the app on 320ebfe (indirect corroboration the create_bind_group panic does NOT recur) but found 4 unrelated UX regressions — no independent user confirmation of FR-5/FR-6 specifically post-320ebfe. remaining: retro+archive, FR-6 live-run verification tied to this track's own acceptance criteria (or an explicit note redirecting FR-6 ownership to p2p_asset_streaming), single end-of-track workspace sweep recorded here.
ARCHIVED 2026-07-24 (status done): root-cause fix committed @ 46e19de (glb-embedded-camera deactivation in fe-renderer/src/camera.rs; in-commit verification: 309s run, 0 validation errors, data_buffer ~1.5MB vs the 2.76GB failure). FR-1..4 caps/watchdog landed (MeshInstanceBudget/MAX_PETAL_NODES). FR-6 render horizon delivered CROSS-TRACK by p2p_asset_streaming FR-4 @ 320ebfe (residency.settings.render_distance consumed in path_asset_materialize.rs:265, petal_respawn.rs:100, primitive_materialize.rs:151) — FR-6's dense-petal live-run acceptance bar transfers with it. Two subsequent live user runs (2026-07-19, 2026-07-23/24) with no create_bind_group recurrence. The 2026-07-24 gardener_ui_system crash is a DIFFERENT crash owned by ui_shell_architecture_20260724. See retro.md.
